result.citation: Jersey City Code § 218-12(2)(a) (Ord. 25-057, as amended by Ord. 25-076); see also id. § 218-12(2)(b), (4)
result.citation_basis: § 218-12 and subsections 2(a), 2(b): D035, O082; Ord. 25-057: D035, O084; Ord. 25-076: O082; enforcement renumbered to subsection 4: O083
result.official_quote: It is unlawful for any real estate lessor, agent, or subcontractor thereof, to subscribe to, contract with, or otherwise exchange anything of value in return for or otherwise utilize the services of a Service Provider.
result.note: The citation now pinpoints subsection 2(a), which holds the ban, and adds Ord. 25-076 because that ordinance last changed this subsection (adding 'or otherwise utilize'). It also points to the service-provider ban in 2(b) and to enforcement and penalties, which Ord. 25-098 renumbered as subsection 4. The section is not yet codified: Municode's current § 218-12 is still 'Exempt dwellings', so the quote comes from the amending ordinance.
